subject.title: fix(agents): let harness-owned compaction proceed without ambient auth

question: Should harness-owned compaction be permitted to proceed without a verified host route whenever no ambient host API key exists, relying on the runtime's own credential store?
rationale: The patch deliberately narrows a fail-closed auth guard; source-level confirmation of the runtime-owned authentication contract and maintainer acceptance of that boundary are required before merging.

options.title: Confirm and merge the no-key exception
options.body: Accept the scoped exception after independently confirming the Codex auth-store and automatic-compaction contracts plus redacted after-fix runtime proof.

options.title: Keep unconditional route locking
options.body: Retain the existing guard if maintainers require all native compaction attempts to have host-side route preparation, even when no ambient key is passed.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge the no-key exception
recommendation.body: Accept the scoped exception after independently confirming the Codex auth-store and automatic-compaction contracts plus redacted after-fix runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR context connects steipete directly to the runtime diagnosis and the proposed auth-boundary adjustment.
